working_title: FiberGuard: Exact Representation Certificates and Their Failure at the Inductive Boundary

claims.statement: For a complete finite representation fibre, exact target diameter, deterministic action regret, randomized expected regret, and epsilon-safe action sets are representation-owned quantities.
claims.forbidden_extension: No unseen-state or richer-representation upper bound follows.

claims.statement: A deterministic worst-fibre action-regret value has a witness on at most the action count, and minimal unsafe conflicts have size at most the action count.
claims.forbidden_extension: The witness bound is not a sample-complexity or prevalence result.

claims.statement: Minimum-cost static exact representation repair is a weighted set-cover problem over induced target-disagreement pairs or minimal action-conflict hyperedges.
claims.forbidden_extension: Generic set-cover complexity and approximation receive zero novelty credit.

claims.statement: State-dependent adaptive acquisition is exactly represented by Pareto-pruned statewise loss profiles, while scalar Bellman recursion is universally exact exactly under cell-constant child charges.
claims.forbidden_extension: A childwise maximum charge is only an upper bound and may select the wrong policy.

claims.statement: Randomized adaptive value is the minimax value over the convex hull of deterministic policy profiles, with a mixed-tree upper certificate of support at most the fibre size and a dual Bayes-tree lower certificate.
claims.forbidden_extension: Expected-loss improvement is not pathwise, tail, or adaptive-adversary safety.

claims.statement: Finite training fibres do not certify unseen same-signature states without completeness, a structural extension law, or an explicitly statistical authority class; exact equality coverage and certificate validity are separate quantities.
claims.forbidden_extension: Neighborhood coverage is not an exact certificate without a proved law.

claims.statement: Safe fallback routing requires paired learned/fallback evidence, correct acquisition timing, pre-acquisition measurability, and a sign margin under any registered transfer drift.
claims.forbidden_extension: Marginal learned-action calibration does not certify fallback alignment or transfer.

claims.statement: The registered R8 finite panels contain exact representation collisions in graph coloring, set cover, and 2-SAT, with refinement successes and failures preserved.
claims.forbidden_extension: No production prevalence or learned-model error rate follows.

claims.statement: On the complete seven-vertex graph atlas, the six-vertex C4 repair fails to transfer while graphlet and combined refinements close the registered target ambiguity.
claims.forbidden_extension: No asymptotic or large-graph transfer follows.

claims.statement: On pinned ASlib SAT12-ALL, exhaustive same-corpus evaluation selects Pre plus lobjois with robust total excess 1712, compared with 12000 for no features and 16906.55 for all feature steps.
claims.forbidden_extension: No held-out, learned-selector, or cross-scenario authority follows.

claims.statement: Under prospectively frozen held-out evaluation, exact numeric equality has very low recurrence and poor decision value, refuting its inductive use on SAT12-ALL.
claims.forbidden_extension: The adverse terminal may not be hidden behind the transductive result.

claims.statement: A prospectively frozen coarsening improves mean behavior but does not earn the registered robust transfer terminal.
claims.forbidden_extension: Mean improvement is not robust certificate value.

claims.statement: Across the frozen SAT16, SAT18, and SAT20 sequence, marginal learned-action calibration can coexist with harmful fallback alignment, including sign reversals across scenarios.
claims.forbidden_extension: Marginal coverage is not selective routing value.

claims.statement: The R12, R13, R17, and R18 finite verifiers corroborate the exact policy, randomization, alignment, timing, and transfer identities under fail-closed authority flags.
claims.forbidden_extension: Same-owner CI is not external reproduction.
